# InfoSec Black Friday Deals 2026 Edition

A yearly list of InfoSec Black Friday deals, plus homelab hardware and other "non-security" tech. No Amazon links, no VPNs, no junk. Every deal was checked to be live when it was added, and I try to keep the garbage out.

Inspired by [0x90n/InfoSec-Black-Friday](https://github.com/0x90n/InfoSec-Black-Friday) and [CriimBow/InfoSec-Black-Friday](https://github.com/CriimBow/InfoSec-Black-Friday).

Even if something makes the list, do your due diligence so you aren't getting screwed out of your hard-earned money. **DO YOUR OWN RESEARCH!** Investing in yourself is important, but don't spend money you don't have.

- Deals are publicly announced and sourced from emails, social media, and sites I like.
- No tracking or affiliate links. This isn't monetized.
- Each table is sorted by end date, soonest first. Ended deals get struck through and moved to the bottom automatically.

**Legend:** 💖 training I've taken and liked · ✨ gear or services I've used · ~~struck through~~ means the deal has ended

**44 active deals** of 44 listed
